teaching.title: Programming Tutor
bullets: Prepared practice questions for individual tutoring sessions covering variables and conditionals, as well as functions.
Guided beginning programmers through practice exercises and asked learners to explain the steps in their solutions.

teaching.title: Peer Programming Mentor
bullets: Helped peers trace short programs step by step during beginner practice sessions on debugging, variables, and conditionals.
Explained worked examples on debugging, variables, and conditionals under a course instructor's supervision.

projects.title: Truth-Table Explorer
bullets: Constructed examples and counterexamples for the represented rules as a contributor to a team truth-table explorer project using Python.
Explained the connection between formal definitions and implementation, and tested the implementation against hand-worked cases.

projects.title: Document Lookup
bullets: Wrote tests for insertion, lookup, and deletion in an individual document lookup project using Python and Git.
Compared alternative data structures for the document lookup project's insertion, lookup, and deletion operations.
